commit_message: Remove PowerShell SHA256 dependency from ADR0155
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0155 managed Local AI
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0155 managed Local AI and fixes Windows GGUF/runtime SHA-256 verification to use the OS command boundary without depending on the unavailable PowerShell Get-FileHash cmdlet.
